name: AVANGAAD
recent: Avangaad Berhad 最近公布了截至2026年9月30日止季度的业绩，9个月净利同比增长43%至2400万令吉。公司董事局出现变动，Mohd Faris Adli Bin Shukery 于11月6日辞去非独立非执行董事职务。此外，Johor Corporation、Sindora Berhad 和 Kulim (Malaysia) Berhad 在9月底不再是大股东。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩发布，9个月净利同比增长43%至2400万令吉。
Mohd Faris Adli Bin Shukery 于2026年11月6日辞去非独立非执行董事职务。
Johor Corporation、Sindora Berhad 和 Kulim (Malaysia) Berhad 于2026年9月28日及29日公告不再是大股东。
risks: 执行董事 Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 在2026年9月24日于公开市场收购了278,384,300股普通股，占已发行股份的20.99%。
公司公告了在闭门期内的交易意向，涉及执行董事 Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn。
新闻报导 Hussin 兄弟在反贪会调查期间被安排休假，其中 Nazir 也在 Kinergy 卸任。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，公司营收为3276.8万令吉，环比增长4.8%，同比增长1.5%；净利为1048万令吉，环比增长106.4%，同比增长73.9%；净利率为32.0%，高于上一季度的16.2%。

recent_en: Avangaad Berhad recently announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with 9-month net profit rising 43% year-on-year to RM24 million. There was a boardroom change as Mohd Faris Adli Bin Shukery resigned as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director on 6 November. In addition, Johor Corporation, Sindora Berhad and Kulim (Malaysia) Berhad ceased to be substantial shareholders at the end of September.
notable_en: Quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 were released, with 9-month net profit up 43% year-on-year to RM24 million.
Mohd Faris Adli Bin Shukery resigned as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director effective 6 November 2026.
Johor Corporation, Sindora Berhad and Kulim (Malaysia) Berhad announced on 28 and 29 September 2026 that they ceased to be substantial shareholders.
risks_en: Executive Director Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired 278,384,300 ordinary shares, representing 20.99% of issued shares, in the open market on 24 September 2026.
The company announced an intention to deal during the closed period involving Executive Director Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn.
News reports stated that the Hussin brothers were placed on garden leave amid an MACC probe, with Nazir also stepping aside at Kinergy.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM32.768 million, up 4.8% QoQ and 1.5% YoY; net profit was RM10.48 million, up 106.4% QoQ and 73.9% YoY; net margin was 32.0%, higher than 16.2% in the previous quarter.
